name: Bonus 1: A Simple Day's Commute
source:
Just a normal, boring day's commute to work for the three friends. At least, it would be if Ashley wasn't there...

[From [url=https://www.azdev.org/download]the official website[/url]]
translation:
对这三位好友来说，这本该只是一趟平平无奇、枯燥乏味的上班通勤路——至少，要是艾什莉不在场的话确实如此……

[摘自[url=https://www.azdev.org/download]官方网站[/url]]
